newsitem.title: UK: Persimmon says trading still ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Persimmon says trading still ahead of budget.

text.p: Persimmon Plc said that trading remains buoyant and it is still ahead of budget for the current financial year.

"At the time of our preliminary announcement on March 10 we indicated that we were ahead of budget with sales of 2,834 homes," chairman Duncan Davidson told the annual meeting. "Since that time trading has continued to be buoyant and we have remained ahead of our budget for the year".
"We reiterate our confidence in the future and look forward to reporting further progress at our interim results in September," he said in a statement.
Improving trading conditions in the South East are spreading to other operating companies across the UK and margins are improving, Davidson added.
Persimmon shares were up 2-1/2 pence at 240-1/2 at 1120 GMT.
